hypothesis: A source-structured analytic procedural background improves public Flag/Bomb posterior calibration versus uniform legal armies.
motivation: v3 procedural heldout audit found3/32 first-step Flag predictions98.5–99%confidently wrong; exact-prefix action lookup did not fix them. The source procedural component is explicitly not uniform legal armies.

facts.fact: At Colonel phase3 the procedural Flag is always physical backrow1, canonical origins30..39.
facts.evidence: PLAC.C initial_row expression chooses row2 only with phase<3; phase3 sets row1, then SEARCH.C takes available backrow column.

facts.fact: An interior backrow Flag receives Bombs immediately left/right and in front, plus two mobile guards on the forward diagonals.
facts.evidence: PLAC.C row==1, noncorner branch puts originalrank11 in three screen squares and originalrank5/6 guards.

facts.fact: Corner Flag has two screen shapes: adjacent2Bombs when rng%5==1, otherwise outer3Bombs. Each places two mobile guard squares.
facts.evidence: PLAC.C corner branch; nominal20/80 split is approximate because successive original RNG draws are correlated.

facts.fact: The screen Bombs and Flag remain fixed; the two guard squares remain mobile, but their exact ranks need not stay5/6.
facts.evidence: Additional placements use cleared occupancy markers. Final repair excludes Flag0/Bomb11 and swaps mobile ranks only; another mobile may be swapped into a guard square.

facts.fact: Extra Bombs start in physical rows1..3, select flank/adjacency-filtered vacancies and may fallback to later rows.
facts.evidence: PLAC.C count[11] loop calls setup_marked_cell(11,rng%3+1). SETUP.C uses flank sums, avoids adjacency and corner conditions, then SEARCH.C scans cyclic rows if needed.

facts.fact: Mobile assignments are also role/row-biased, so an exchangeable mobile likelihood remains an approximation.
facts.evidence: PLAC.C explicitly places Miners, two strong officers, Spy and rank-specific row distributions before filling Scouts and final repair.

proposed_model.outer_prior: Keep0.8source-template/0.2background fixed. Replace only background by(1-epsilon)*source-structural +epsilon*uniform legal armies.
proposed_model.latent_geometries: 12cases:8interior Flag columns with3Bomb adjacent screen;2corner columns each with2Bomb adjacent or3Bomb outer screen. Flag-column mass initiallyuniform1/10; nominal source corner weights.2/.8.
proposed_model.fixed_positions: Each geometry has FlagF, fixedBomb setB0, fixedmobile setM0. No invented hard exact guard ranks.
proposed_model.residual_Bombs: Choose exactly k=6-|B0| additionalBombs from A=40origins excludingF/B0/M0 with probability proportional to product of strictlypositive row weights. This is a conditional-Bernoulli fixed-size distribution, analytically marginalized rather than empirical whole-army particles.
proposed_model.mobile_ranks: Allocate the known33mobile ranks uniformly under exact remaining counts over all nonimmobile origins. Explicit role/row-likelihood approximation; do not claim original-generative exactness.
proposed_model.fitting: Fit four residual-Bomb row odds from fresh training procedural armies using fixed Beta(1,1) smoothing: (residualBombs_row+1)/(eligible_nonBombs_row+1), normalize arbitrary common scale away. No rank-value scores or strategic coefficients.
proposed_model.full_support: epsilon chosen only on independent calibration among prespecified.01,.05,.10,.20,.50,1.0; epsilon1 reproduces existing uniform background exactly, serving as an explicit fallback. Uniform tail makes every legal count-consistent army retain positive mass.
proposed_model.inference: For each geometry enforce all historically known original identities including captured pieces and all moved origins. Marginalize every compatible residualBomb subset and every count-consistent mobile assignment, not exact-rank particles.

derivation.partition: Z_g=e_k({w_s:s in A_g}), elementary symmetric polynomial computed in O(40k).
derivation.evidence: Let R be publicly knownBomb origins not inB0, and E eligible residual slots after excluding known mobiles and moved origins and R. Geometry likelihood factor is prod(w_R)*e_(k-|R|)(w_E)/Z_g, zero for contradictory fixed Flag/Bomb/mobile facts.
derivation.mobile_factor: Multiply by prod_r falling(C_r,K_r)/falling(33,K_mobile) for disclosed mobile rank identities; this includes captured revelations. Unlike full-army particles, every compatible mobile rank assignment is analytically marginalized.
derivation.geometry_posterior: Normalize prior geometry weights times evidence and mobile factor, retaining absolute evidence for mixture competition with templates/uniform component.
derivation.marginals: Conditional residualBomb inclusion at s is w_s*e_(remaining-1)(E without s)/e_remaining(E), plus fixedBomb point masses; Flag is a geometry point mass. Sum over posterior geometries.
derivation.sanity_identity: A generic version with all40Flagpositions, no fixed screens/guards, equal weights and6residualBombs must reproduce existing uniform background_log_evidence exactly for every small enumerated public event.

explicit_nonclaims: This is a defensible source-informed approximation, not exact original PRNG joint distribution.
No calibrated mobile role model is assumed.
No runtime source, adapter, policy or registry is changed.
No CX16 code-size or cycle-cost feasibility claim; current target banks are constrained.
implementation_stage: Proposal and derivation before new generator sampling; use fresh train/calibration/heldout seed pools under a separately frozen protocol.
